leads.name: The Hos platan (Hero Plane) of Varosliget
leads.why_a_lead: A single, specific plane tree in Varosliget nominated by the Ligetvedok (park-defender activists) for the 2016 Az Ev Faja contest, winning a special 'Hos Fa' (Hero Tree) award; evfaja.hu/scoreboard/2016 gives a specific GPS point (47.510432, 19.085797), ~200 years old, 30m tall, 5.7m trunk circumference, a genuinely distinct single specimen (not the separate 180-200y row of planes along the lake shore at 47.513817, 19.083098, ~390m away, which is an avenue/group and blocked separately below). REJECTED THIS PASS on an alive-now risk: multiple 2020/2023 Hungarian news sources (pestisracok.hu, index.hu, mandiner.hu, metropol.hu) report that the Ligetvedok's own camp caught fire on 26 March 2020 in the 'central area' of Varosliget, badly burning a '100+ year old plane tree' (60% of the trunk circumference burned to 4.5-5m height), which died over the following years and was felled in late 2023/2024, with a new sapling planted in its place. No source explicitly confirms or denies that the felled tree IS the 2016 Hos platan, but the coincidence (same activist group, same park, same rough age, both framed as a plane the Ligetvedok were protecting) is too close to ignore. Publishing this as alive without resolving the identity question risks shipping a dead tree.
leads.next_step: A future pass should try to pin down the exact felled tree's location (none of the fire/felling articles give coordinates) against the evfaja.hu GPS point for the Hos platan, or find a post-2020 photo/status update of the Hos platan specifically. If they are confirmed to be different trees, the Hos platan (47.510432, 19.085797) becomes a strong candidate: single tree, precise GPS from source, good story (hero-tree award, Liget Budapest development controversy). UPDATE this pass: fetched evfaja.hu/scoreboard/2016 directly and confirmed the Hos Fa award (Varosliget hos platanja, 47.510432, 19.085797, 200y/30m/5.7m) is a genuinely separate entry from that year's main Ev Faja winner (the Jaszai Mari ter plane, a different tree entirely, which a search engine's own AI summary had wrongly conflated with this one, worth noting since that conflation could mislead a future pass too). Also found: the 2020 fire report's only location detail is that the Ligetvedok camp stood near Otvenhatosok tere / the Neprajzi Muzeum construction site, which geocodes roughly 780m from the Hos platan's GPS point, and the burned tree is independently described as 30m tall (matching the Hos platan's height exactly) but only '100+ years old' (vs. the Hos platan's claimed 200). Net effect: leans toward these being different trees (distance argument) but does not resolve it (no source states the camp tree's precise coordinates, height match is suggestive the other way, and 'over 100 years' does not contradict 'roughly 200'). Still not safe to ship. Same recommendation stands, with the distance data point added for whoever picks this up next.

leads.name: The linden (hars) of Gazda utca, Hidegkut
leads.why_a_lead: Cited by enbudapestem.hu's '10 oldest trees of Budapest' listicle as possibly the city's single oldest tree, 250-500 years old, in Pesthidegkut (Budapest II. kerulet).
leads.next_step: Not pursued further this pass: the source describes it standing in the courtyard/garden of a private house. If it turns out to be visible or accessible from the street, it could be verified properly; if it is genuinely on private grounds with no public access, it is a hard rule 10 block, not a lead. Needs an access check before any further research time is spent.

leads.name: The second plane tree at the Buda approach to Elizabeth Bridge (Erzsebet-hid), beside Rudas Gyogyfurdo
leads.why_a_lead: RESOLVED IN PART this pass: the better-documented of the two bridgehead planes (the Dobrentei ter corner specimen, protected since 2011, trunk over 4m, ~115 years old) shipped this pass as bud_009, sourced from pestbuda.hu's two-part history and FOKERT's own notable-trees page. The SECOND tree, standing south of the bridgehead immediately beside Rudas Gyogyfurdo itself, remains unverified: pestbuda.hu and welovebudapest.com both mention it exists and is of similar age, but neither gives its trunk size, a FOKERT page for it specifically was not found this pass (only the Dobrentei ter one turned up), and no second independent source was located in the time available.
leads.next_step: Search FOKERT's notable-trees index (fokert.budapestikozmuvek.hu/nevezetes-fak) directly for a dedicated Rudas-side plane entry, or check Budapest I. kerulet's own protected-tree list for a second Erzsebet-hid entry. If it verifies, it stands close enough to bud_009 (a few hundred metres) to extend the same small Taban/Castle cluster.

leads.name: Kerepesi Cemetery (Fiumei uti sirkert) veteran trees
leads.why_a_lead: The brief flagged Kerepesi Cemetery's arboretum-like planting (56 hectares, described repeatedly as resembling an arboretum) as promising ground. Searched for a specific named/dated veteran tree within the cemetery; found only general descriptions of 'rich vegetation' and no individually documented old tree with age or species given.
leads.next_step: A future pass could try the cemetery's own management body (Nemzeti Orokseg Intezete, which runs fiumeiutisirkert.nori.gov.hu) directly, or search for a dendrological survey of the cemetery specifically, rather than general history searches which surface only the notable graves.

leads.name: The historic plane trees along Varosliget lake (Varosligeti-to)
leads.why_a_lead: evfaja.hu/fa/2017/varosligeti-menten-allo-evszazados-platanok describes a group/row of century-old planes (180-200 years, planted 1818-1830 as an Archduke Joseph gift) along the City Park lake shore, GPS 47.513817, 19.083098, 32m tall, 450cm trunk circumference.
leads.next_step: BLOCKED as an entry, not a lead: the source itself frames this as 'this tree group' collectively, a row along the shoreline rather than one identifiable specimen with one obvious place to stand. Does not pass the collectible-point test. If a single stand-out tree within the row can be individually identified in a future pass, it could be reconsidered.

leads.name: The Black Walnuts by the Grand Hotel (Nagyszallo)
leads.why_a_lead: FOKERT has a dedicated page for this group (fokert.budapestikozmuvek.hu/nagyszallo-melletti-fekete-diok-juglans-nigramargitszigeti-nevezetes-fak) and enbudapestem.hu's listicle independently lists 'three black walnuts near the Grand Hotel, ~200 years, planted by first head gardener Karoly Tost' as its own entry. Not opened this pass. FOKERT's page for bud_010 (the Franciscan-ruins walnut) explicitly compares this group unfavourably in size ('jointly the largest of these is still 119cm smaller in circumference than the tree profiled here, as of 2017'), which is useful corroboration that both groups are real, distinct, documented specimens.
leads.next_step: This is three trees, which fails the one-collectible-point test unless they stand close enough together to read as a single obvious ensemble (unclear from the snippet, needs the FOKERT page open to check). If they are a tight, named grove near a specific building entrance the way the Seven Chieftains precedent works, it could ship as one ensemble entry; if they are scattered, at most the single largest of the three should be considered. Verify location and spacing first via a rendered browser session.

leads.name: The Giant Wild Pear of Godollo (Vén Vackor)
leads.why_a_lead: Verify pass 2026-09-27 (Tree of the Year batch 2, target '_tree-of-the-year'). Fully verifies on every normal test: alive, sourced twice over, publicly reachable, genuinely famous (Hungary's 2013 national Tree of the Year, 2nd place / 36,925 votes in the 2014 European Tree of the Year contest, selected for the cross-border Wise Trees Project in 2021). Held back from shipping as a Budapest addition on ONE ground only: real transit time from central Budapest is too far to read as a day-trip addition to that city page, not a fact or access problem.

verified_facts.location: Godolloi Botanikus Kert (Godollo Botanical Garden, run by MATE / formerly Szent Istvan University), Pater Karoly utca 1, Godollo, Pest county. Stands roughly 100m from the garden entrance in a clearing behind a row of false cypresses, in the centre of the garden's layout; OSM's own 'Botanikus kert' polygon (leisure=garden, way 272087868) centres at 47.5935, 19.3673, matching the contest page's stated GPS (47.595114, 19.367294) closely, and Nominatim confirms Pater Karoly utca 1 sits on the same MATE university campus (way 226399604, bounding box 47.5889-47.5985 lat / 19.3581-19.3723 lon).
verified_facts.species: Wild Pear, Pyrus pyraster. Agreed by every source (contest page, evfaja.hu, the garden's own MATE page, elmenyterkep.hu, turistamagazin.hu).
verified_facts.age: MATE's own botanical-garden page (godolloibotanikuskert.uni-mate.hu/ven-kortefa), last content-dated 2023, gives 'Fa becsult kora: 289 ev' (estimated age 289 years) alongside height 17.5m; the 2014 contest era sources say 280 years. The two figures rise consistently with the years between them (280 in 2014, 289 as of ~2023), which reads as genuine institutional tracking rather than a static repeated number, though no ring count or growth-rate working was found; treat as a repeated estimate from the tree's own caretaker institution rather than a derived figure.
verified_facts.girth: 320-321cm trunk circumference reported consistently by evfaja.hu (321cm) and a search-engine summary of turistamagazin.hu/origo.hu coverage ('over 320cm'); height reported as 17.5m (MATE's own page, 2023) to 20m (contest page, elmenyterkep.hu), a real range across sources rather than an error, given tree height estimates commonly vary by measurement method and year.
verified_facts.access: Genuinely public, PAID ENTRY: Godollo Botanical Garden charges 800 HUF adult / 500 HUF reduced (per elmenyterkep.hu, prices as of ~Feb 2026 search data), open Mon-Thu 08:00-16:00, Fri 08:00-14:00, closed to individual visitors on weekends (groups only, by prior reservation). This clears hard rule 10's paid-entry test cleanly, no access concern at all.
verified_facts.alive_now: Confirmed as of 2023: the tree's own institutional page (MATE, godolloibotanikuskert.uni-mate.hu) is content-dated 2023 and describes its 2021 Wise Trees Project participation in the present tense, with no mention of decline. Good, recent, first-party evidence of continued life.

leads.why_not_shipped_as_budapest_addition: Real one-way transit time from central Budapest is roughly 70-90 minutes door to door: the H8 HEV suburban line from Ors vezer tere (the M2 metro terminus, itself 10-15 min from central Budapest by metro) to Godollo takes about 45 minutes on its own (confirmed by multiple transit sources), and the Godollo HEV station sits close to 1km / a 12-15 minute walk from the botanical garden entrance. That is well past the ~30 minute public-transport day-trip boundary BRIEF_RESEARCH.md and this project's own day-trip rule use for a tree to 'belong on the city page' honestly labeled, as opposed to a separate destination reached via Budapest. 24.6km straight-line distance was already at the outer edge of that test before the real transit time was checked; the checked time confirms it does not clear the bar.
leads.next_step: This is not a research gap, it is a container decision: Godollo (famous for the Grassalkovich Palace, a genuine tourist destination in its own right, reachable by the same HEV line) is a strong candidate to become its OWN place later under the single-famous-tree / own-destination logic this project already applies elsewhere, rather than being squeezed into Budapest's day-trip radius. A future pass opening Godollo as its own city/place can lift this lead directly; all facts above are already verify-pass complete (two sources, pin, access, alive-now).
